svg.title: MediaHub Relational Schema
svg.desc: Relational schema for all eighteen implemented tables with primary keys foreign keys unique constraints and defaults.
svg.text: MediaHub Relational Schema
18 implemented PostgreSQL tables • PK primary key • FK foreign key • arrows identify referenced relations
Identity and security
ROLES(id PK, name UNIQUE NOT NULL)
USERS(id PK, role_id FK → ROLES.id, google_subject UNIQUE, email UNIQUE, display_name, status DEFAULT ACTIVE, ...)
USER_SESSIONS(sid PK, sess JSONB NOT NULL, expire NOT NULL)
ACCOUNT_DELETION_CHALLENGES(user_id PK/FK → USERS.id, code_hash, expires_at, attempts DEFAULT 0, requested_at)
AUDIT_LOGS(id PK, actor_user_id FK → USERS.id NULL, action, entity_type, entity_id, old_values, new_values, created_at)
Catalogue
MEDIA_TYPES(id PK, code UNIQUE, name UNIQUE, section, progress_mode)
MEDIA_ITEMS(id PK, media_type_id FK → MEDIA_TYPES.id, created_by_user_id FK → USERS.id NULL, title, normalized_title, ...)
GENRES(id PK, name UNIQUE, slug UNIQUE)
MEDIA_GENRES(media_item_id PK/FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, genre_id PK/FK → GENRES.id)
MEDIA_UNITS(id PK, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, parent_unit_id FK → MEDIA_UNITS.id NULL, unit_kind, sequence_number, ...)
Personal tracking
LIBRARY_ENTRIES(id PK, user_id FK → USERS.id, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, current_unit_id FK → MEDIA_UNITS.id NULL,
status DEFAULT PLANNED, progress_value DEFAULT 0, rating NULL, UNIQUE(user_id, media_item_id), ...)
PROGRESS_EVENTS(id PK, library_entry_id FK → LIBRARY_ENTRIES.id, unit_id FK → MEDIA_UNITS.id NULL, old_progress, new_progress, ...)
External sources connections and ingestion
SOURCES(id PK, key UNIQUE, name UNIQUE, connector_kind, base_url, is_enabled DEFAULT true, terms_checked_at)
USER_CONNECTIONS(id PK, user_id FK → USERS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id, external_user_id, encrypted tokens,
status DEFAULT CONNECTED, last_synced_at, UNIQUE(user_id, source_id), ...)
EXTERNAL_MAPPINGS(id PK, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id, external_id, source_url,
UNIQUE(source_id, external_id), last_synced_at DEFAULT now())
INGESTION_JOBS(id PK, requested_by_user_id FK → USERS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id NULL, kind, status, counters, ...)
INGESTION_CANDIDATES(id PK, job_id FK → INGESTION_JOBS.id, source_id FK → SOURCES.id, media_type_id FK → MEDIA_TYPES.id,
match_media_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id NULL, external_id, normalized_payload JSONB, decision, UNIQUE(job_id, source_id, external_id))
Recommendations
RECOMMENDATIONS(id PK, user_id FK → USERS.id, media_item_id FK → MEDIA_ITEMS.id, score, model_version, reason, feedback,
generated_at DEFAULT now(), expires_at NULL, UNIQUE(user_id, media_item_id, model_version, generated_at))
Implemented query support
Views user_library_summary media_popularity_summary
Function get_user_genre_profile(UUID) Trigger library_entry_update_audit_trigger
Indexes catalogue search library status and recency progress history ingestion queues ranked recommendations audit lookup
